minutes.headline: Stormwater Task Force tabled its reorganization to August and heard ARPA money is unlikely for stormwater projects.
minutes.summary: The task force tabled reorganization until the August meeting, approved the prior minutes, and heard that the town manager showed little interest in using ARPA funds for stormwater. Most of the meeting was a briefing on failing detention basins at the Village of Flat Hill development and the town's possible role, plus a discussion of silt and bank erosion on the Malpas Brook near Hickory Hills. The next meeting was set for August 17 and the meeting adjourned.
